# LinkedIn Company Firmographics

> Send a LinkedIn company URL. You get the website, industry, employee range, headquarters, founded year, and follower count.

Mawsool publishes this as an Apify Actor. Starting from $0.45 per 1,000 companies.

## Run

- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-company-firmographics
- Call: `oday/mawsool-linkedin-company-firmographics`
- API key: https://mawsool.tech/ and https://docs.mawsool.tech/
- Contact: osama@mawsool.tech, info@mawsool.tech

## Use it when

You need the firmographic fields, not the post history.

## Use something else when

You also need locations, specialties, and recent posts. Use LinkedIn Company Details.

## Page

- Firmographics from a LinkedIn company URL: docs/linkedin-firmographics.md

Mawsool is not affiliated with LinkedIn.
